article.linkText: Oklahoma City hosts conference rival Los Angeles
article.story: Los Angeles Clippers (1-1, seventh in the Western Conference) vs. Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, second in the Western Conference) Oklahoma City; Sunday, 7 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles plays Oklahoma City in Western Conference action Sunday. Oklahoma City went 64-18 overall, 41-11 in Western Conference action and 34-8 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Thunder averaged 119.0 points per game while allowing opponents to score 107.9 last season. Los Angeles went 42-40 overall and 25-27 in Western Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Clippers averaged 23.7 assists per game on 40.5 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Thunder: Nikola Topic: day to day (back), Thomas Sorber: day to day (knee), Otega Oweh: out for season (achilles). Clippers: Max Strus: out (foot), Yanic Konan Niederhauser: day to day (lisfranc), Jordan Miller: out (shoulder), Brandon Ingram: day to day (heel), Bradley Beal: day to day (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
